BiblicalUsage: Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah, but he tarried longer than the set time which the king had appointed him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe delay is the quiet way a mission fails: Amasa did not refuse, he tarried, and the set time passed, and Joab did the work instead.
